title: Transport of exterior tensor extensionality to the official exterior powers
statement: For a scheme X, the sheafification of the older exteriorSheafPresheaf M n is canonically isomorphic to the official exteriorPower M n, by identity maps on sectionwise exterior powers. The inverse takes the official wedge of any tuple to exteriorSheafSection of that tuple. For any epi g : B → C, this comparison transfers exteriorTensor_lift_hom_ext to morphisms out of exteriorSheaf A r tensor exteriorSheaf C s, with the identical hypothesis on tensors of lifted pure wedges.

source.place: Proof of (*), determinant paragraph, lines 140–147; comparison of the two implementations required by the human retirement hand-off of 2026-10-20

proof.text: Both restriction maps extend the same alternating map on pure wedges. Uniqueness in exteriorSheafRestriction_existsUnique and the official exteriorPower_map_ιMulti show that the identity components give a presheaf isomorphism. Apply the sheafification functor to obtain exteriorSheafPowerIso. Naturality of its adjunction unit identifies the inverse on wedge sections. This construction uses no arbitrary existence witness.

Tensor the comparisons for A and C and precompose the two given morphisms with the inverse tensor isomorphism. Apply the official exteriorTensor_lift_hom_ext to these composites. tensorHom_app_tmulSection and the inverse wedge formula identify its generator condition with the given condition. Cancel the epimorphic inverse isomorphism. This works also in degree zero and over the empty scheme or zero ring.

lean.statement:
theorem exteriorSheafTensor_lift_hom_ext {X : Scheme.{v}} {A B C D : X.Modules}
    (g : B ⟶ C) [Epi g] (r s : ℕ)
    (φ ψ : exteriorSheaf A r ⊗ exteriorSheaf C s ⟶ D)
    (h : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a : Fin r → A.val.obj (op U))
      (c : Fin s → B.val.obj (op U)),
      φ.val.app (op U)
          (tmulSection (exteriorSheafSection A r U a)
            (exteriorSheafSection C s U (fun i ↦ g.val.app (op U) (c i)))) =
        ψ.val.app (op U)
          (tmulSection (exteriorSheafSection A r U a)
            (exteriorSheafSection C s U (fun i ↦ g.val.app (op U) (c i))))) :
    φ = ψ
